source.text: ወእምድኅረ፡ አማንት፡ መዋዕል፡ በውእቱ፡ መካን፡ በኀበ፡ ርእኩ፡ *ኵሎ፡ ራእያተ፡ ዘበኅቡእ፡ እስመ፡ ተመሥጥኩ፡ *በነኰርኵረ፡ ነፋስ፡ ወወሰደኒ፡ ኀረበ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: After those days, in that place where I had seen all the hidden visions, I was swept away in a whirlwind, and it carried me west.

footnotes.text: The actual printed132 star before all is retained. The133 continuation is the relative expression ዘበኅቡእ, not the adjective copied in the first author draft. Primary Dillmann600–601 supports hidden/secret and the adverbial in-secret construction. The singular carried-me verb is retained without identifying a new angel carrier.

source.text: በህየ፡ ርእየ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኀቡአተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ዘይሄሉ፡ ህሉ፡ ደብረ፡ ኀጺን፡ ወደብረ፡ ጸሪቅ፡ ወደብረ፡ ብሩር፡ ወደብረ፡ ወርቅ፡ ወደብረ፡ ነጠብጣብ፡ ወደብረ፡ ዐረር።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: There my eyes saw all the hidden things of heaven that are there: a mountain of iron, a mountain of copper, a mountain of silver, a mountain of gold, a mountain of easily melted metal, and a mountain of lead.

footnotes.text: Easily melted metal renders ነጠብጣብ by its primary lexical description, metallum quod facile liquescit, not by an undisclosed identification with a modern alloy. Copper is the ordinary metal sense of ጸሪቅ, also used for bronze; the final ዐረር is lead. This is a list of six mountains, not a numeral printed in the source.

source.text: ወተሳእልክዎ፡ ለመልአክ፡ ዘ*ምስሌየ፡ የሐውር፡ እንዘ፡ እብል፡ ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ *አማንት፡ ኵሉ፡ እለ፡ በኅቡእ፡ ርእኩ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: I asked the angel who was walking with me, “What are all these things that I have seen in secret?”

footnotes.text: The final selected expression is በኅቡእ, in secret, not the first draft misreading በግቡእ. Actual Dillmann600–601 gives the hidden/secret range and in-occulto construction. The first-person I saw and accompanying angel remain unchanged; this is a glyph correction from the actual primary photo, not adoption of another textual witness.

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ እሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዘርእከ፡ ለሥልጣነ፡ መሲሕ፡ አማንት፡ ይከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ የአዝዝ፡ ወ*ይትኀየል፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: He said to me, “All these things that you have seen will serve the authority of the Anointed One, so that he may command and exercise power on the earth.”

footnotes.text: The selected noun is Anointed One, and the purpose verbs are command and exercise power. No later personal name is inserted. Serve the authority renders the purpose relation, not an additional act of worship.

source.text: ወአውሥአ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብለኒ፡ ውእቱ፡ መልአክ፡ ሰላም፡ ጽናኅ፡ ንስቲተ፡ ወይትከሠት፡ ለከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘኀቡአ፡ ዘከለለ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈስት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: That angel of peace answered me, “Wait a little, and everything hidden that the Lord of Spirits has surrounded will be revealed to you.”

footnotes.text: The selected final verb is ዘከለለ, not the first draft miscopy ዘተለለ. Actual Dillmann816 gives the enclose/encircle sense under ከለለ; the rendering surrounded is retained. The selected wording is not replaced with the planted reading reported in Charles95 note28. Wait-a-little and will-be-revealed retain their force.

source.text: ወ*እሎንቱ፡ አድባር፡ ዘ†*ርእየ፡ አዕይንትከ፡ ደብረ፡ ኀጺን፡ ወደብረ፡ ጸሪቅ፡ *ወደብረ፡ ብሩር፡ *ወደብረ፡ ወርቅ፡ ወደብረ፡ ነጠብጣብ፡ *ወደብረ፡ ዐረር፡ እሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለኅሩይ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ መዓረ፡ ገራ፡ በቅድመ፡ እሳት፡ ወከመ፡ ማይ፡ ዘይወርድ፡ እምላዕሉ፡ ዲበ፡ አማንት፡ አድባር፡ ወይከውኑ፡ ድኩማነ፡ በቅድመ፡ እገሩ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: These mountains that your eyes have seen—the mountain of iron, the mountain of copper, the mountain of silver, the mountain of gold, the mountain of easily melted metal and the mountain of lead—all of them will be before the Chosen One like beeswax before fire and like water flowing down onto those mountains from above. They will become powerless before his feet.

footnotes.text: The dagger and selected stars remain. The final actual expression is before his feet; the first draft extra suffix on before is removed. Primary Dillmann207 controls honey, and1153 explicitly gives the honey-plus-wild compound as cera, wax. Easily melted metal uses the primary697 description rather than an undisclosed modern alloy identification.

source.text: ወይከውን፡ በአማንት፡ መዋዕል፡ ኢይድኅኑ፡ እምወርቅ፡ ወእምብሩር፡ ወኢይክሉ፡ ጐዩ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: In those days they will not be saved by gold or silver, and they will not be able to escape.

footnotes.text: Both negatives are retained. The source does not name a new subject here; they carries forward the people implicit in the judgment context, not an additional proper name.

source.text: ወኢይከውን፡ ኀጺን፡ ለዐቅብ፡ ወኢይለብሱ፡ ለድርዖ፡ አንገድዓ፡ ኢይበቅዖ፡ ጸሪቅ፡ ወናእክ፡ [ኢይበቅዖ፡ ወ]ኢይትኃሰይ፡ ወኢዐረር፡ ኢይትፈቀድ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: Iron will not be available for protection, and they will not clothe the shoulder in armor. Copper will be of no use. Tin will be of no use and will have no value, and lead will not be reckoned.

footnotes.text: The armor clause remains provisional; shoulder renders the visible አንገድዓ rather than dropping it. The selected armor form is ለድርዖ. All selected negatives, including bracketed ኢይበቅዖ ወ, are kept in meaning. Primary665 gives ናእክ a lead/tin range; tin distinguishes it provisionally from separate ዐረር lead. The exact printed following verb and its meaning require independent recheck; have no value is not certified. No reported variant is adopted to repair this unit.

source.text: እሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ [ይትከሐዱ፡ ወ]ይትኀጐሉ፡ ህልወ፡ እምገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ሶበ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ኅሩይ፡ በቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መናፍስት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: All these things will be denied and destroyed from the face of the earth when the Chosen One appears before the Lord of Spirits.

footnotes.text: Denied and is bracketed in the selected source, not added from a newly inspected manuscript. The proposal includes its sense and preserves the remainder destroyed/from-earth/Chosen-One/before-Lord. The infinitival being expression is rendered as destruction of their existence rather than omitted as a separate event.

source.text: በህየ፡ ርእየ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ቆላ፡ *ርኁወ፡ ወዕሙቀ፡ አፉሁ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወባሕር፡ ወደሴት፡ አምኀ፡ ወአስተያ፡ ወጋዳ፡ የመጽኡ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ ቆላ፡ ኢይመልእ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: There my eyes saw a valley whose mouth was open and deep. All who dwell on dry land, the sea and the islands bring gifts, presents and offerings, yet the whole deep valley will not be filled.

footnotes.text: The source piles up dwellers, gifts/presents/offerings and people bringing them. The English joins the clauses but does not add a destination or name the recipients. The final not-be-filled negative is retained. Dry land, sea and islands are all included.

source.text: ወጋዳየ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ ይጸምዑ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘይጸምዕ፡ ለ*ጋዳየ፡ ኀጥኣን፡ ይበልዑ፡ ወእምገጸ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ ይትኀጐሉ፡ [ኀጥኣን]፡ ወእምገጸ፡ ምድሩ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ይትቀወመው፡ ወ[ኢ]የኀልቁ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: They toil over the offerings of their hands, and sinners devour everything that toils for an offering. The sinners will be destroyed from before the Lord of Spirits; they will be driven away from the face of his earth, and they will not come to an end forever.

footnotes.text: This is a deliberately provisional rendering. The offering/toiling/devouring relations are difficult. The source brackets the repeated sinners and the negative ኢ before come-to-an-end. This proposal keeps the bracketed negative in English rather than silently producing the opposite meaning. Being driven away follows primary Dillmann 453 abigi, segregari, explicitly citing this verse; it is not interpreted as successfully standing against the Lord.

source.text: እስመ፡ ርእክዎሙ፡ ለ*ኵሎሙ፡ መላእክተ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ እንዘ፡ *የኀድሩ፡ ወያስተዳልዉ፡ ኵሎ፡ መባልዕተ፡ ለሰይጣን።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: For I saw all the angels of punishment dwelling there and preparing every instrument for Satan.

footnotes.text: Instrument is provisional for the selected መባልዕተ, whose printed form differs from common clothing/equipment words. The source says for Satan, not explicitly Satan himself manufacturing tools. No additional torture inventory is inserted.

source.text: ወተሳእልክዎ፡ ለመልአክ፡ ሰላም፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ምስሌየ፡ እሎንቱ፡ መባልዕት፡ ለመኑ፡ ያሰተዳልውዎሙ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: I asked the angel of peace who was walking with me, “For whom are they preparing these instruments?”

footnotes.text: The equipment noun is retained as instruments provisionally, in continuity with 53:3. The selected question is for whom, not what purpose or what materials.

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ እሎንቱ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወለኀያላን፡ ዘንቱ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይትኀጐሉ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: He said to me, “These are for the kings and the mighty of this earth, so that by them they may be destroyed.”

footnotes.text: The kings/mighty of this earth and destruction are explicit. By them conveys the means relation to the objects being prepared; it does not add a named executioner.

source.text: ወእምድኅረ*ዝ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ *ጽድቅ፡ ወኅሩይ፡ ቤተ፡ ምስትጉባኤ፡ ዚአሁ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ ኢይትከልእ፡ በስመ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈስት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: After this, righteousness and the Chosen One will appear. After this, his house of assembly will not be withheld, in the name of the Lord of Spirits.

footnotes.text: The selected text has righteousness, not a silently substituted righteous person. Its relation to the Chosen One and the following house of assembly is unresolved. The assembly compound has primary congregation/meeting support, but that does not settle the syntax. The negative will not be withheld and both after-this expressions are retained.

source.text: ወ*ኢእሉ፡ አድባር፡ ይከውኑ፡ በቅድመ፡ ጽድቁ፡ ከመ፡ ምድር፡ ወአውግር፡ ይከውን፡ ከመ፡ ነቅዐ፡ ማይ፡ ወ*የዐርፉ፡ ጻድቃን፡ እምጻማ፡ ኀጥኣን።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: These mountains will not remain before his righteousness, like the earth; the hills will become like a spring of water, and the righteous will rest from the suffering caused by sinners.

footnotes.text: The initial negative ኢ is visibly present and retained. The selected phrase like the earth is not silently changed into flat earth, nor is the negative dropped to match another version. Suffering caused by sinners uses the primary injury/misery range of ጻማ with its genitive. The mountains/earth comparison still needs syntactic review.

source.text: ወገጽኩ፡ ወተመየጥኩ፡ ካልአ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ወርእኩ፡ በህየ፡ ቆላ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ እንዘ፡ ትነድድ፡ እሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: I turned and went toward another region of the earth. There I saw a deep valley with fire burning in it.

footnotes.text: The narrator remains first person. Another region renders another face of the earth; fire is explicit and no named underworld location is added.

source.text: ወ*አምጽእዎሙ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወለኀያላን፡ ወይወድይዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝኩ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ ቆላ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: They brought the kings and the mighty and cast them into that deep valley.

footnotes.text: The source does not name the subject of they brought/cast in this verse. No new angel is inserted; both kings and mighty are retained.

source.text: ወበህየ፡ ርእየ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ዘ*መባልዕቲሆሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይገብርዎሙ፡ ማእሰርተ፡ ኀጺን፡ ዘአልቦ፡ መይድኖት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: There my eyes saw their instruments being made: iron bonds of immeasurable weight.

footnotes.text: Iron bonds and no measure are explicit. Weight is a provisional interpretation of the selected final measuring noun, and the equipment form has the same unresolved problem as 53:3–4.

source.text: ወተሳእልክዎ፡ ለመልአክ፡ ሰላም፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ምስሌየ፡ እንዘ፡ እብል፡ እሉ፡ አስራት፡ [መባልዕት]፡ ለመኑ፡ ይደልዎ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: I asked the angel of peace who was walking with me, “For whom are these bonds—these instruments—prepared?”

footnotes.text: The selected source brackets the second noun as an explanatory gloss, according to the actual printed98 note1. Bonds is the concrete sense of the rare አስራት discussed by Charles on printed97 note44; the primary lexical binding range is consistent. Instruments is provisional for the bracketed noun and is not erased from the proposal.

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ እሉ፡ ይደልዎ፡ ለትዕይንተ፡ አዛዝኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይትመጠውዎሙ፡ ወይወድይዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝኩ፡ ደይን፡ ወአልባብን፡ ጠዋያን፡ ይከድኑ፡ መልታሒሆሙ፡ በከመ፡ አዘዘ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈስት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: He said to me, “These are prepared for the host of Azazel, so that they may be handed over and cast into that condemnation. Crooked stones will cover their jaws, as the Lord of Spirits commanded.”

footnotes.text: The actual jaw form is መልታሒሆሙ; first-draft መልታሕቶሙ was a transcription error. Primary Dillmann45 explicitly cites54:5 for the jaw noun. The selected adjective has the primary1241 curved/twisted range, rendered crooked rather than inventing a rough texture or replacing jaws with faces. Primary225 supports the passive hand-over sense;1007 supports host/group. No fresh manuscript or extra textual reading is claimed.

source.text: ወሚካኤል፡ ወገብርኤል፡ ወሩፋኤል፡ ወፋኑኤል፡ ወእቶሙ፡ ይጸንዕዎሙ፡ በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ዐባይ፡ ወውስተ፡ እቶን፡ ዘይነድድ፡ ይወድይዎሙ፡ ውእተ፡ ዕለተ፡ ከመ፡ ይትበቀል፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ *እግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ በዐመጾሙ፡ በእንተ፡ ዘኮኑ፡ ለሰይጣን፡ ወአስትዮሙ፡ ለእለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: Michael, Gabriel, Rufael and Phanuel will seize them on that great day and cast them into the burning furnace on that day, so that the Lord of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their wrongdoing, because they belonged to Satan and led astray those who dwell on dry land.

footnotes.text: The four selected Ethiopic names are retained, including Rufael and Phanuel. Primary Dillmann1290 explicitly cites54:6 under strict holding, apprehending, restraining, supporting seize here rather than strengthen them. Belonged to Satan renders the selected became/were for Satan without adding the noun servants. The furnace/casting and dry-land-dwellers relations remain complete.

source.text: [ወበውእቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይወጽእ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ለእግዚአ፡ *መንፈስት፡ ወትረኀዉ፡ ኵሉ፡ መኃዝብተ፡ *ማያት፡ ዘመልዕልተ፡ ሰማያት፡ [ወዲበ፡ አናቅጽት፡ እለ፡ መትሕተ፡ ሰማያት፡] ወ*እለ፡ አናቅጽት፡ መትሕተ፡ ምድር።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: In those days the punishment of the Lord of Spirits will come forth, and all the storehouses of waters above the heavens will be opened, and above the gates that are beneath the heavens, and those gates beneath the earth.

footnotes.text: The whole flood section begins with an editorial bracket here and continues beyond chapter54; that opening bracket is retained without falsely closing the section at this verse. A separate inner bracket encloses and above the gates that are beneath the heavens. This deliberately awkward proposal includes that printed phrase; the actual98 note34 calls it a marginal gloss and describes its reported textual construction. No reported reading is adopted to smooth it. The storehouse/gate syntax remains unresolved.

source.text: ወይደመራ፡ ኵሉ፡ ማያት፡ [ዘ]ምስለ፡ ማያት፡ ዘመልዕልተ፡ ሰማያት፡ ተባዕታይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወማይ፡ ዘመትሕተ፡ ምድር፡ አንስታይ፡ ይእቲ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: All the waters will mingle with the waters above the heavens, which are male; the water beneath the earth is female.

footnotes.text: The source changes number and gender in describing the waters; English keeps the male/female distinction instead of replacing it with modern hydrology. The relative ዘ before with is bracketed. The mingling relation and whether all-waters functions as the subject need syntactic review; the primary mixture and male/female senses are controlled.

source.text: ወይደመሰስ፡ ኵሉ፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ *ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወእለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ መትሕተ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ሰማይ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: All who dwell on dry land and all who dwell beneath the ends of heaven will be wiped out.

footnotes.text: The selected wiping-out verb is retained, controlled by the primary erase/destroy range. Beneath the ends of heaven is not silently changed to a different geographic phrase or only the land.

source.text: ወ*በእንተ፡ ዘአእመርዎ፡ በዐመጾሙ፡ እንተ፡ ገብሩ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወበይእቲ፡ ይትኀጐሉ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: Because of what they knew, through the wrongdoing they committed on earth, they will be destroyed by it.

footnotes.text: This is a literal provisional construal of the selected knowledge verb and wrongdoing expression. The actual99 note12 discusses a Greek reconstruction, not an extant Greek manuscript inspected here. That printed reconstruction is not adopted as translation input. The final by-it feminine relation is retained provisionally; the clause must not be freely replaced with they recognized their wrongdoing after judgment.
